name: Youth Health Exploration Camp
org: University of Detroit Mercy, College of Health Professions
what_you_do: Try health care skills hands on. You learn hands-only CPR, check vital signs and use a hospital simulator. You also tour campus and meet health workers.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students who want to explore health careers. No experience needed.
pay_detail: Free. Breakfast, lunch and snacks are included. Campers also get a lab jacket and a blood pressure cuff.
duration: One week. In 2026 the high school week was July 27 to 31, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp is full. Dates for 2027 are not posted.
how_to_apply: The 2026 camp is full, so you cannot apply now. The program page does not post 2027 sign-up dates. Questions can go to Nina Favor at favornf@udmercy.edu.
notes: Held at the STAR Center on the McNichols Campus. The middle school week was July 20 to 24, 2026. The high school week was July 27 to 31, 2026.
